title: glab api projects/${project}/merge_requests/${n}/closes_issues?per_page=100 --paginate
description: The issues a merge request closes when merged, ${project} the project's path URL-encoded and ${n} its iid, which kit draws with the open change in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:open-prs, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::gitlab_pr) and prints as number, state, and project (forge/gitlab:pr-closing-issues); --paginate prints one such array per page. GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, names APIEntitiesMRNote for GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/closes_issues, but the answer is issues, so the types are its APIEntitiesIssue, and the state's values those of https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/#list-issues-that-close-on-merge.

iid.description: The issue's number in its project.

full.description: The issue's reference with its project's full path, as group/project#7.
